flows: paging: Next shows the server's second page (2 entries, 6–7 of 7) and is then withheld; Previous returns to the first
sort: the Sort combobox orders by Name (Bell Tower, Ferryman, Fog Market, Lantern Bridge, Old Mill) and back
search: a title or key finds its entry ("mill": Old Mill); no match says so; clearing it shows the first page again
marks: Pin and Off press, are the server's, reach a second socket's copy (lore:marked), survive a reload and drive the Pinned and Off filters; pressed again they release
rankings: the fixture's turn judges the two entries its line names, and both copies show it without a reload (lore:ranked)
